text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Tamamo Cross! Tamamo Cross!
The champion of the Arima Kinen is Tamamo Cross!!
(Woooooaaaaahhhhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(So this is how strong Tamamo-san
and Oguri-san really are...)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(However, my mastery of "Unison of Fire and Water"
is steadily rising as well. If this keeps up—)
(WOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Tamamo Cross-san!
Could you share your thoughts with us right now?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Well, that's just obvious!!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
How did you feel about your
showdown with Oguri Cap-san?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You kept talkin' big about wanting to beat me,
but you're a hundred years too early!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Come back in 100 years!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, Tamamo Cross!
You're the strongest!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Don't give up as the representative of the next generation!
Keep challenging them, as many times as it takes, Oguri!!"

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Though she suffered defeat against Tamamo Cross-san, no one can deny the sheer strength of Oguri Cap-san!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
As the representative of the current Classic generation,
it seems immense expectations are resting on Oguri Cap!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...The representative of our generation...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (...Oguri-san is beyond doubt a formidable powerhouse.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (However, the one who contested the Classic Triple Crown was—)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap rivals Tamamo Cross in both popularity and ability.
She's sure to bring excitement to next year's Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Well, she's a rival recognized by Tamamo herself, so 'course she is!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
If we're talking about the current Classic generation,
Super Creek's looking very promising too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Man, Oguri's in a league of her own!
I can't wait to see just how many G1s she's gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (—Why is my name not being called!?)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Today, I ran alongside Oguri-san!
And now I stand right before the crowd!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Is there no one... who will bring up that fierce battle, the Japanese Derby?!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Like I'd let you!!
Not in this Derby, absolutely not!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I can't yield, I won't yield!!
I'm going to win for Maruzen-san's sake too!

text_block_list.name: Ardan & Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaaaaah!!
Yaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I don't care if my legs shatter into pieces!!
I will burn up this very life
and carve proof that I existed right here and now!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, nooo!!
*I'm* going to win the Derby! Meeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ORRAAAAAAHHHHHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Chiyono O's all-out, desperate run!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Ardan-san's resolve to bet it all!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (My fierce sprint, biting right at their heels!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Even now, it's burned vividly into my mind
and makes my heart tremble!!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Though maybe no one's actually
waiting for me, but..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...How many people out there
still remember my name,
even though I'm no longer racing...?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The more time passes,
the more forgotten I'll become...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Why must Chiyono O-san and the others
have to fear that they might have
no place to return to?!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I, who ran with both of you, am right here!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Look upon me!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek! Ogriii!!
Look over hereee!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Ogurii! Today was disappointing,
but we have high hopes for next year!!
(WAAAH! WAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...If that is so... then I will...!!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaagh, aaaaaaaaaaahh!!

Looking up at the sky in the middle of the turf,
Yaeno Muteki roars.
A roar of fury that threatens to trample the heavens.

However, her screams of fury were drowned out
by the euphoric cheers praising the two Umamusume,
never reaching the audience's ears—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Trainer-dono, hear my words!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: My objective is to defeat Oguri-san!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Word on the street is that Oguri-san is the strongest of all!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I shall triumph over Oguri-san
and prove my strength once and for all!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've defeated Oguri-san,
the world will no longer be able to ignore me!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Then they will surely remember!
That we were the ones who ran the Classic Triple Crown races,
and that we are the ones who carry this generation!

Yaeno Muteki rattled that off in one breath,
with a blazing, fiery rage
radiating from her entire body.

She is completely beside herself with rage.
Yet, what that furious passion seeks is—

"I want to beat Oguri Cap."
It was an "obsession" so fierce, it felt like a raging storm.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer-dono!
I would like to hear your opinion!

I simply present the conclusion to Yaeno Muteki,
knowing she is currently in no state to make a calm judgment.

It was a goal she desired so intensely that it became an obsession.
I'll gladly give her my full support.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Just as I had hoped!
How delightful!!"
